name: Blue Ghost Mission 1

narrator.name: Blue Ghost
narrator.role: the lander that made it upright

intro: Hi! I'm Blue Ghost, a private lander with ten NASA experiments on board.
Target: Mons Latreille, a small volcanic hill in Mare Crisium.
I'll even film a sunset on the Moon. Bring popcorn!
Choose a spot where I'll get two weeks of good sunlight.
briefing: Descent going well. Hazard cameras scanning the ground.
fact: Blue Ghost landed upright and worked for a full lunar day, then filmed the sunset.
